mapper.select: WITH candidate AS ( SELECT sa.id AS stage_attempt_id, gj.id AS generation_job_id, gj.job_id, gj.project_id, pris.story_version_id, pris.resolution, pris.render_format, pris.aspect_ratio, pris.total_duration_ms, pris.render_profile_json::text AS render_profile_json, sa.status AS stage_status, gj.status AS job_status FROM stage_attempts sa JOIN generation_jobs gj ON gj.id = sa.generation_job_id JOIN project_render_input_snapshots pris ON pris.generation_job_id = gj.id WHERE gj.job_type = 'RENDER_PROJECT' AND gj.resource_class = 'CPU_RENDER' AND gj.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'STALLED') AND sa.stage_name = 'RENDER_PROJECT_LOCAL' AND pris.execution_target = 'LOCAL_DEVICE' AND pris.assigned_local_device_id = #{deviceId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ( sa.status IN ('QUEUED', 'STALLED') OR ( sa.status = 'RUNNING' AND ( sa.heartbeat_at IS NULL OR sa.heartbeat_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{leaseSeconds} * INTERVAL '1 second') ) ) ) ORDER BY sa.created_at, sa.id FOR UPDATE OF sa, gj SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ), stage_claim AS ( UPDATE stage_attempts sa SET status = 'RUNNING', worker_id = #{workerId}, lease_token = #{leaseToken,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 FROM candidate c WHERE sa.id = c.stage_attempt_id AND sa.status = c.stage_status RETURNING sa.id ), job_claim AS ( UPDATE generation_jobs gj SET status = 'RUNNING', progress = CASE WHEN gj.status = 'STALLED' THEN 5 ELSE GREATEST(gj.progress, 5) END, current_step = CASE WHEN gj.status = 'STALLED' THEN 'RENDER_PROJECT_LOCAL_RETRYING' ELSE 'RENDER_PROJECT_LOCAL' END, error_code = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 FROM candidate c WHERE gj.id = c.generation_job_id AND gj.status = c.job_status RETURNING gj.id ) SELECT c.stage_attempt_id AS stageAttemptId, c.generation_job_id AS generationJobId, c.job_id AS jobId, c.project_id AS projectId, c.story_version_id AS storyVersionId, c.resolution, c.render_format AS renderFormat, c.aspect_ratio AS aspectRatio, c.total_duration_ms AS totalDurationMs, c.render_profile_json AS renderProfileJson FROM candidate c JOIN stage_claim sc ON sc.id = c.stage_attempt_id JOIN job_claim jc ON jc.id = c.generation_job_id

SELECT chapter_id AS chapterId, chapter_order_index AS orderIndex, global_start_ms AS globalStartMs, global_end_ms AS globalEndMs, narration_asset_id AS narrationAssetId, audio_storage_key AS storageKey, audio_size_bytes AS sizeBytes, audio_checksum AS checksum, audio_duration_ms AS durationMs, subtitle_text AS subtitleText, subtitle_spans_json::text AS subtitleSpansJson FROM project_render_input_chapters WHERE generation_job_id = #{generationJobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} ORDER BY chapter_order_index, chapter_id

SELECT chapter_id AS chapterId, scene_index AS sceneIndex, beat_index AS beatIndex, visual_beat_id AS visualBeatId, media_asset_id AS mediaAssetId, global_start_ms AS globalStartMs, global_end_ms AS globalEndMs, duration_ms AS durationMs, camera_movement AS cameraMovement, storage_key AS storageKey, size_bytes AS sizeBytes, checksum FROM project_render_input_beats WHERE generation_job_id = #{generationJobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} ORDER BY global_start_ms, scene_index, beat_index, visual_beat_id
mapper.update: UPDATE generation_jobs gj SET progress = GREATEST(gj.progress, #{progress}), current_step = #{currentStep}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE gj.job_id = #{jobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND gj.status = 'RUNNING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stage_attempts sa JOIN project_render_input_snapshots pris ON pris.generation_job_id = sa.generation_job_id WHERE sa.generation_job_id = gj.id AND sa.stage_name = 'RENDER_PROJECT_LOCAL' AND sa.status = 'RUNNING' AND sa.worker_id = #{workerId} AND sa.lease_token = #{leaseToken,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND pris.execution_target = 'LOCAL_DEVICE' AND pris.assigned_local_device_id = #{deviceId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} )
mapper.select: SELECT fa.render_fingerprint AS renderFingerprint, fa.storage_key AS storageKey, fa.storage_provider AS storageProvider, fa.external_file_id AS externalFileId, fa.web_view_link AS webViewLink, fa.mime_type AS mimeType, fa.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, fa.checksum_sha256 AS checksumSha256, fa.duration_ms AS durationMs, fa.width, fa.height, CAST(ROUND(fa.fps) AS INTEGER) AS fps FROM final_artifacts fa JOIN generation_jobs gj ON gj.id = fa.generation_job_id WHERE gj.job_id = #{jobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND fa.artifact_type = 'PROJECT_VIDEO' AND fa.status <> 'ARCHIVED' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO final_artifacts ( project_id, chapter_id, generation_job_id, render_manifest_id, artifact_type, render_fingerprint, storage_key, mime_type, size_bytes, checksum_sha256, duration_ms, width, height, fps, status, storage_provider, external_file_id, web_view_link ) SELECT gj.project_id, NULL, gj.id, NULL, 'PROJECT_VIDEO', #{renderFingerprint}, #{storageKey}, #{mimeType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{checksumSha256}, #{durationMs}, #{width}, #{height}, #{fps}, 'READY', #{storageProvider}, #{externalFileId}, #{webViewLink} FROM generation_jobs gj JOIN project_render_input_snapshots pris ON pris.generation_job_id = gj.id WHERE gj.job_id = #{jobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND pris.execution_target = 'LOCAL_DEVICE' AND pris.assigned_local_device_id = #{deviceId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}
mapper.update: UPDATE stage_attempts sa SET status = 'COMPLETED', heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE sa.stage_name = 'RENDER_PROJECT_LOCAL' AND sa.status = 'RUNNING' AND sa.worker_id = #{workerId} AND sa.lease_token = #{leaseToken,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM generation_jobs gj JOIN project_render_input_snapshots pris ON pris.generation_job_id = gj.id WHERE gj.id = sa.generation_job_id AND gj.job_id = #{jobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND pris.execution_target = 'LOCAL_DEVICE' AND pris.assigned_local_device_id = #{deviceId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} )

UPDATE generation_jobs gj SET status = 'COMPLETED', progress = 100, current_step = 'COMPLETED', error_code = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE gj.job_id = #{jobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND gj.status = 'RUNNING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_render_input_snapshots pris WHERE pris.generation_job_id = gj.id AND pris.execution_target = 'LOCAL_DEVICE' AND pris.assigned_local_device_id = #{deviceId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} )

UPDATE stage_attempts sa SET status = 'CANCELED', worker_id = NULL, lease_token = NULL, heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE sa.stage_name = 'RENDER_PROJECT_LOCAL' AND sa.status = 'RUNNING' AND sa.worker_id = #{workerId} AND sa.lease_token = #{leaseToken,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM generation_jobs gj JOIN project_render_input_snapshots pris ON pris.generation_job_id = gj.id WHERE gj.id = sa.generation_job_id AND gj.job_id = #{jobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND gj.status = 'RUNNING' AND pris.execution_target = 'LOCAL_DEVICE' AND pris.assigned_local_device_id = #{deviceId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} )

UPDATE generation_jobs gj SET status = 'CANCELED', current_step = 'CANCELED', error_code = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE gj.job_id = #{jobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND gj.status = 'RUNNING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_render_input_snapshots pris WHERE pris.generation_job_id = gj.id AND pris.execution_target = 'LOCAL_DEVICE' AND pris.assigned_local_device_id = #{deviceId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} )

UPDATE stage_attempts sa SET status = CASE WHEN #{retryable} THEN 'STALLED' ELSE 'FAILED' END, worker_id = NULL, lease_token = NULL, heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE sa.stage_name = 'RENDER_PROJECT_LOCAL' AND sa.status = 'RUNNING' AND sa.worker_id = #{workerId} AND sa.lease_token = #{leaseToken,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM generation_jobs gj JOIN project_render_input_snapshots pris ON pris.generation_job_id = gj.id WHERE gj.id = sa.generation_job_id AND gj.job_id = #{jobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND pris.execution_target = 'LOCAL_DEVICE' AND pris.assigned_local_device_id = #{deviceId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} )

UPDATE generation_jobs gj SET status = CASE WHEN #{retryable} THEN 'STALLED' ELSE 'FAILED' END, current_step = CASE WHEN #{retryable} THEN 'RENDER_PROJECT_LOCAL_RETRY' ELSE 'FAILED' END, error_code = #{errorCode}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE gj.job_id = #{jobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND gj.status = 'RUNNING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_render_input_snapshots pris WHERE pris.generation_job_id = gj.id AND pris.execution_target = 'LOCAL_DEVICE' AND pris.assigned_local_device_id = #{deviceId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} )
